# Short address for the TV app, self-healing screensaver
### New
- **Get the Android TV app onto the TV without typing a long link:** the server now redirects its short address `<server>/app` (for example `192.168.1.20:8090/app`) to the newest app file – enter it in the free *Downloader* app on the TV. *Devices → ＋ Add device* has a new block "Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV or Shield: install the Frameside app" (three steps, the address is shown for you, a note about the screensaver). Translated into English, French, Dutch and Spanish.
### Fixed
- **The app's screensaver (version 1.2.1) heals itself:** if the server or the network goes away the screen stays black (instead of a browser error page) and reloads every 20 seconds, or at once when the network is back; if the display crashes it is rebuilt. Before, the screensaver stayed stuck after an outage.

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. APK: Frameside-TV.apk below. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
